names.name: Samvit

names.name: Sanak

names.name: Sanandan
names.note: One of the four Kumaras, Brahma's mind-born sons who chose lifelong childhood and celibacy.

names.name: Sankarshan

names.name: Sanman

names.name: Sanvad

names.name: Sarit

names.name: Sarovar

names.name: Satark

names.name: Sattva

names.name: Satyaki

names.name: Savata

names.name: Senani

names.name: Setu

names.name: Shakra
names.note: Indra's most common epithet in the Vedas and Buddhist texts, the powerful king of gods.

names.name: Shami
names.meaning: the shami tree (Prosopis), worshipped on Dussehra; also 'calm'

names.note: the Pandavas hid their weapons in a shami tree; Marathi families exchange shami (apta) leaves as 'gold' on Dasara · used for girls too

names.name: Shamit

names.name: Shantam

names.name: Sharva

names.name: Shashin

names.name: Shatanik
names.note: Son of Nakula and Draupadi who fought at Kurukshetra; also the son of Janamejaya who ruled after him.

names.name: Shibi
names.note: The king who cut flesh from his own body to save a dove from a hawk; the gods were testing him.

names.name: Shridam
names.note: Krishna's closest cowherd friend in Vrindavan, brother of Radha in some tellings.

names.name: Shrutasen
names.note: Son of Sahadeva and Draupadi, one of the five Upapandavas.

names.name: Shuka
names.note: Shukadeva, son of Vyasa, the boy-sage so detached that even celestial nymphs felt no shyness before him; he narrated the Bhagavata to King Parikshit

names.name: Shunya

names.name: Skanda
names.note: The war-god son of Shiva who led the gods against Taraka; the Skanda Purana is named for him.

names.name: Smaran

names.name: Somil

names.name: Spandan

names.name: Srijan
names.note: used occasionally in Bengal; creator-maker meaning

names.name: Srujan

names.name: Stavan
names.note: used among Gujarati and Marathi Jain families

names.name: Suchir

names.name: Sudas
names.note: Rigveda: the Bharata king who won the Battle of Ten Kings on the Ravi with Vasishtha as his priest, uniting the early Vedic tribes

names.name: Sukrut
names.note: same Marathi -rut pattern as Amrut

names.name: Sumeru
names.meaning: the excellent Meru, the cosmic mountain
names.note: used across Hindu and Buddhist cosmology

names.name: Sumiran
names.note: bhakti-poetry word in Namdev and Kabir alike

names.name: Sunrit
names.note: Vedic virtue word: speech that is both true and pleasant

names.name: Sushen
names.note: Ramayana: the monkey physician who told Hanuman to fetch the sanjivani herb and revived Lakshmana on the battlefield

names.name: Swarit
names.note: the middle Vedic pitch accent; fresh and short

names.name: Swarnim
names.say_note: reads as written; stress first syllable
names.note: a modern adjective ('Swarnim Gujarat', the golden jubilee) occasionally used as a given name · used for girls too

names.name: Swayam
names.meaning: self, of one's own accord; self-reliant
names.note: used in Maharashtra since the 2000s; not common in the US

names.name: Tandav
names.note: powerful image; some relatives may find it fierce for a baby

names.name: Tansen
names.meaning: after Mian Tansen, the legendary musician of Akbar's court
names.root: Hindi tānsen (तानसेन), from tāna, a melodic run, plus sen
names.note: an honorific-name of one person rather than a common given name

names.name: Tapovan
names.meaning: forest of austerities; a forest hermitage
names.note: a place-word (Tapovan near Nashik and in Uttarakhand) rather than an established given name

names.name: Taral
names.meaning: rippling, liquid, sparkling; the central gem of a necklace
names.say_note: reads as written; stress first syllable
names.note: used for girls too

names.name: Taran
names.meaning: one who carries across, rescuer; raft
names.note: used in Punjab; rare elsewhere

names.name: Tark
names.collisions: one syllable and abrupt; rarely a given name

names.name: Taru
names.note: kalpataru = the wish-granting tree · used for girls too

names.name: Tavas
names.note: Rigvedic noun, not a traditional given name

names.name: Tejomay
names.note: heard in Marathi devotional verse

names.name: Tikona
names.meaning: three-cornered; the triangular fort near Pawna
names.note: Vitandgad; a pretty word even before the fort

names.name: Tishya
names.meaning: auspicious; the Vedic name of the Pushya nakshatra
names.say_note: reads as written; stress on first syllable
names.note: one of the few nakshatra names that is unambiguously masculine · used for girls too

names.name: Toran
names.note: word name, very rare as a given name

names.name: Udar
names.note: a word more than an established name

names.name: Udatt
names.note: also the raised pitch accent in Vedic recitation

names.name: Udyan
names.note: the Udyan Express train links Mumbai and Bengaluru

names.name: Udyot
names.say_note: 'dy' cluster; rhymes with 'good boat' without the b

names.name: Unmukt
names.note: known from cricketer Unmukt Chand; still very rare

names.name: Unnat
names.note: male form of Unnati

names.name: Ushanas
names.meaning: the sage-poet identified with the planet Venus (Shukra)

names.name: Ushinar
names.note: Father of Shibi and himself a byword for charity; some versions give him the dove-and-hawk test

names.name: Utsah
names.note: a word more than an established name

names.name: Utsuk
names.note: a word more than an established name

names.name: Uttank
names.note: Mahabharata: the disciple who fetched a queen's earrings for his guru's wife, braving the serpent world; later Krishna showed him his cosmic form

names.name: Vadal
names.note: purely Marathi word; a boy who arrives like a monsoon squall

names.name: Vadanya
names.note: very rare; a beautiful classical epithet · used for girls too

names.name: Vahni
names.collisions: may be assumed feminine because of the -i ending
names.note: used for girls too

names.name: Vaishakh
names.meaning: the late-spring month (Apr-May) of Buddha Purnima and Akshaya Tritiya
names.say_note: 'vy' as in 'vine'; final kh as hard k

names.name: Varchas
names.note: Vedic word (brahma-varchas = spiritual radiance); rare as a name

names.name: Varenya
names.meaning: excellent, most worthy, to be chosen
names.root: Sanskrit varenya (वरेण्य), from the Gayatri mantra
names.note: the 'varenyam' of the Gayatri mantra

names.name: Varid
names.say_note: reads as written; stress first syllable

names.name: Vasusen
names.note: Karna's birth name, given because he was born wearing golden armor and earrings.

names.name: Vatsa
names.note: Rigvedic rishi of the Kanva line who walked through fire to prove his lineage; the term of endearment elders use for a son.

names.name: Vayu
names.note: deity name, rarely used as a given name

names.name: Vibodh
names.say_note: final dh is just a soft d; 'bode' rhymes with 'road'

names.name: Vichar
names.say_note: stress on the second syllable; ch as in 'church'
names.note: an everyday Marathi word, rarely a given name

names.name: Vidrum
names.say_note: reads as written; stress first syllable
names.collisions: second syllable is the English word 'room'
names.note: one of the nine gems (navaratna)

names.name: Vihayas
names.note: poetic Sanskrit word for sky; not the same as the popular Vihaan

names.name: Vinamra
names.note: fresher than the older-generation Vinay/Vinit

names.name: Vinyas
names.note: also the arrangement of syllables in a raga phrase

names.name: Vismay
names.note: used in Maharashtra and Gujarat; the rasa of wonder in aesthetics

names.name: Vivasvan

names.name: Viyat
names.say_note: reads as written; stress first syllable
names.note: used in classical poetry for the vault of the sky; nearly unused as a given name

names.name: Yajat
names.meaning: holy, worthy of worship (epithet of Shiva)

names.name: Yuyutsu
names.meaning: eager to fight for the right
names.note: Mahabharata: Dhritarashtra's son by a Vaishya woman who alone crossed to the Pandava side at Kurukshetra and later ruled as regent
